name: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Inc.
blurb: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Inc. (MUFG) is Japan's largest financial group, offering banking, trust, securities, and asset management services through its subsidiaries, including MUFG Bank. It operates globally with a strong presence in Asia, the Americas, and Europe. As of 2026, MUFG is one of the world's largest financial institutions by assets, and its earnings are influenced by Japan's rising policy rates and cost reduction efforts.
